class: Any claim that a failing test is 'pre-existing' or 'unrelated' that is not proven by running it on a clean checkout of the base branch can hide a regression the change itself caused, and turns it into a deferred issue nobody fixes.
mechanism: The W-024 builder 'proved' the failure pre-existing by loading HEAD:backend/ofo/wording.py - HEAD being its own branch, which already contained the change - and filed deferred issue #38.

first_seen.evidence: builder: '1 failed ... pre-existing'; orchestrator on main 83e7263: tests/timeline/test_why.py -> 7 passed; #38 closed as filed in error

fix: Builder brief line: 'pre-existing' is proven on origin/main, never on your branch; the orchestrator re-runs any such claim on main before accepting it.

detection.note: Orchestrator habit plus brief line; no automated check.

occurrences.evidence: deferred #38 filed for the branch's own regression
